title: A full page needs a middle key
hook: A full child needs room before the next insertion.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary search-tree ordering; subtree size and interval notation.
doesNotKnow: Split a full B-tree child and promote its median before descent.

misconception: A B-tree grows by adding one binary-tree node per key.
objective: Split a full B-tree child and promote its median before descent.

claims.text: Before descending into a full child, splitting promotes its median and leaves two legal children. The root may grow a level, but all leaves keep the same depth.
